items.title: Every affine blowup algebra of a reduced ring is reduced
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if R is reduced then every affine blowup algebra of R is reduced (statement lines 17522-17528, with the author's slogan that being reduced is invariant under blowup). The proof does not exhibit the blowup algebra as a subring of a known reduced ring: it takes a nilpotent element x/a^n, clears denominators to get a^N x^m = 0 in R, adjusts N so that it is a multiple of m in order to read the relation as a power of a^e x, and then applies reducedness of R to conclude x/a^n = 0 (proof lines 17530-17537). The exponent bookkeeping that produces the m-th power is the substance, and the author writes it out. H2.
